infectionStatus.en: Medical tests confirm that the operator is non-infected.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

value.en: Medical tests confirm that the operator is non-infected.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en: Claims to be a descendant of an Iberian Royal Navy admiral and a member of the fallen noble house, the De Toledo family, having gathered a large following across Iberia. However, due to severe discrepancies between her oral accounts and the Inquisition's archived records, her occupation was reclassified as a freelancer upon registration with Human Resources. De Toledo joined Rhodes Island under the recommendation of Operator Irene. Her eloquence and knowledge of Iberia are sufficient to assist operators in the Iberian Affairs Office with basic operations.
text.zh: 自称伊比利亚王室海军将领后裔、失落的贵族——德·托莱多家族成员，在伊比利亚各地招揽了一大批拥护者。但由于该干员口述的经历与审判庭档案记录严重不符，她的职业在人事部重新登记时，被划定为自由职业。德·托莱多由干员艾丽妮推荐加入罗德岛。她的口才和对伊比利亚的了解，足以辅助伊比利亚办事处的干员完成基础工作。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows detected. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system show no anomalies. There are no signs of Oripathy infection, confirming the subject as non-infected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator De Toledo shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium Crystal Density] 0.12u/L
Operator De Toledo has had very little contact with Originium, but her physical exam report still indicates multiple abnormal metrics: dehydration, anemia, chronic malnutrition... It can be inferred that her past travels wandering across Iberia were exceedingly harsh. The Medical Department will continue to monitor her basic health condition.

"...I naturally understand that your medical records are private personal data, and we will archive them according to standard procedures, but requesting to encrypt this report seems a bit..."
"No, no, no, you don't get it at all. As a noble, I can't let anyone—especially my followers—know that I suffer from malnutrition! Who'd want to follow a leader who can't even feed herself? Wait a minute... Could this actually be a new angle? Sacrificing her own well-being so her followers can live good lives... Doesn't that sound even more popular with the people? Alright then, no encryption needed!"
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员德·托莱多没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.12u/L
干员德·托莱多甚少接触源石，但她的体检报告仍有多项指标状态异常，脱水、贫血、长期营养不良……可以推测，她过去在伊比利亚各地流浪的经历十分艰苦。医疗部会持续跟进该干员的基础健康状况。

“……我当然明白医疗记录是您的个人隐私，我们会按照标准流程归档，但要求给这份报告加密是不是有些……”
“不不不，你完全不明白。身为贵族我不能让任何人——尤其是我的拥护者知道我营养不良！谁想跟一个自己都吃不饱饭的领袖混呀？欸等等……这说不定是个新的思路？为了让拥护者过上好日子宁愿委屈自己……听上去好像更得民心欸？行，那就不加密啦！”

text.en:
[Operator De Toledo Archive Record]
Archive File 1
Current Process Status: Not Archived
Note: HR personnel are requested to expedite the background check and verify the authenticity of all Operator De Toledo's records. If special circumstances arise, an interview with the operator or relevant individuals may be conducted to confirm details verbally.

Archive File 1
Current Process Status: Returned
Note: I understand that compiling three separate six-hour oral interview recordings is difficult, but raw audio files simply do not meet the archive submission standards. Furthermore, please ensure that grandiose expressions such as "Conquerors of the Seas, the Glorious De Toledo Family" are omitted when transcribing into documentation.

Archive File 1
Current Process Status: Returned Again
Note: Per protocol, the background check should have been completed three months ago—well, my dear HR operator, you have my sympathies. Getting Tefi to utter a single truthful word about her background is indeed a formidable challenge.
Reply: Senior... Who is Tefi?
Reply: Operator De Toledo's nickname. Strange, did you not hear her mention it over these past four months? Wait, you haven't heard her recount "Rhea-Iberia and the Guests from the Deep"? What about "An Officer's Last Snowy Night"?
Reply: Huh...?

It was the first time in my life I had ever heard a speech so passionate, moving, and completely off-the-wall. Operator De Toledo stood at the center of the rec room's sunken lounge, sharing three stories with operators unfamiliar with Iberia and patients undergoing treatment at Rhodes Island. To be honest, she sounded like an utter fraud; perhaps only the children in the front row holding toy sailboats and paper badges were truly fooled. By the way, there are still far too few seats in the rec room—standing for three hours straight is terrible for the back. Fine, I admit I was somewhat moved by this boisterous Liberi myself, to the point of reaching for my wallet when she appealed for "Golden Fleet Preparation Funds." In all fairness, it wasn't really being taken. Like me, most listeners were probably stirred by her Iberian tales rather than actually believing she was some grand noble. Besides, she seems quite good to her followers—she even handled all the sound effects for her speech herself without making them do it.
Regrettably, after three hours, I still had no idea which parts of Operator De Toledo's story were true. I may never be able to complete her archival documentation. But I believe I did figure one thing out—I am not suited to be an HR operator who records and verifies facts. I ought to pursue the creative dream I abandoned long ago. I will join De Toledo's crew as a clerk to write stories for her. When the next HR operator arrives to verify her file, perhaps I will be able to tell them who De Toledo truly is.
—Resignation attachment, from a former HR operator
text.zh:
【干员德·托莱多资料归档记录】
档案资料一
当前流程状态：未入档
批注：请人事干员加快背调进度，确认干员德·托莱多所有资料的真实性。若情况特殊可以与干员本人或其相关人士面谈，依据口述确认资料。

档案资料一
当前流程状态：退回
批注：我知道整理三份各六小时的口述资料很困难，但纯音频文件实在不符合档案提交的格式。另外，请注意整理成文档时不能照搬“海洋的征服者、享有无上荣光的德·托莱多家族”此类浮夸表述。

档案资料一
当前流程状态：再次退回
批注：按规定，背调时间应当在三个月前已经结束——好吧，这位人事干员，我也很同情你，要从特菲口中听到她说一句关于自己身世的实话确实太难了。
回复：前辈……特菲是谁？
回复：德·托莱多干员的昵称啊。奇怪，这四个月里你没听她提起过吗？等等，你没听过她讲的《雷亚-伊比利亚与海中来客》？那《军官死前的最后一个雪夜》呢？
回复：哈……？

那是我有生以来第一次听到如此激昂、动人，又不着调的演说。干员德·托莱多站在活动室的下沉式休息区中央，向不了解伊比利亚的干员和在罗德岛治病的人们讲了三个故事。说实话，她听上去像个十足的骗子，恐怕只有第一排拿着帆船玩具和纸质徽章的孩子才会上当。对了，活动室的座位还是太少了，连站三个小时对腰背不好——好吧，我承认我也有点被这个张牙舞爪的黎博利打动了，甚至在她请求“黄金舰队筹备资金”的时候掏出了钱包。平心而论，这不算上当。包括我在内，很多听众大概都是被她讲的伊比利亚故事感染，而不是真认为她是个响当当的贵族。而且她看上去对手下的拥护者不错，连演讲时的音效都没让他们来弄，全都自己一手包办。
可惜的是，三个小时过去，我还是不清楚干员德·托莱多的故事里有哪几句是真的，我可能永远也完不成她的资料归档了。但我想，我确实搞明白了一件事——我不适合当一名记录以及核对事实的人事干员，我应当去追逐早已被我放下的创作梦。我将以文员的身份加入德·托莱多的队伍，替她写点故事，等到下一位人事干员来核实资料的时候，我说不定就能告诉他，德·托莱多到底是什么样的人。
——辞呈附件，来自曾经的人事干员

text.en:
When Operator De Toledo returns to Rhodes Island with her followers after completing missions for the Iberian Office, they refer to themselves as the "Rhodes Island Auxiliary Navy" and patrol the landship.
Though called a patrol, it resembles sightseeing more than anything. De Toledo refers to the operator dormitories as her "palace," the convalescent garden as her "royal garden," and the Engineering Department as her "armaments factory," drawing no small amount of criticism. De Toledo pays little mind to the opinions around her. She orders children accustomed to sleeping on damp Iberian floors to lie upon her own soft mattress; she escorts critically ill elders to the garden to smell floral scents absent from the seaside; and as for those timid young folks capable of building sturdy contraptions, De Toledo shoves them straight into the Engineering Department. Three days later, those youths and the Engineering operators all have glowing eyes, introducing newly invented equipment even more garrulously than she does. Over time, complaints about De Toledo's domineering antics vanished just as the letters accusing her of hogging the rec room did. Anyone who has interacted with her comes to realize that De Toledo acts just as much as she speaks—and given how endlessly she talks, what she does for her followers is enough to make one temporarily forget that her "followers" are actually "victims" taken in by her scheme—

Victims? I don't understand... Lady De Toledo isn't a storm, so how could we be "victimized" by her? I followed Her Ladyship all the way here from Scaleridge Town with nothing to my name. Her Ladyship put me in charge of cooking, having me boil seaweed soup for everyone. Of course, we couldn't always gather enough seaweed, so we'd mix in a little sand. She said once she found a reliable benefactor or got her own estate, she'd bring us all over to drink soup made of pure seaweed. I know this isn't Her Ladyship's home, but I received soup in a place filled with tables and chairs. Lady De Toledo did not deceive me. What? Her identity? Sometimes she really doesn't act like a noble, but none of us know what an Iberian noble is supposed to look like anyway, do we? If those noble lords already rotting in the dirt could be like Her Ladyship, that'd be wonderful. Ah, I remember now! Some followers questioned her before, and she proved her noble bloodline to us. Naval uniform? No, not that. Did you know she has eleven toes?
—A follower of De Toledo, an ordinary Iberian elder, stopping an archivist to speak
text.zh:
当干员德·托莱多完成伊比利亚办事处的任务，带着她的拥护者们回罗德岛的时候，他们会自称“罗德岛下属海军”在基地内巡逻。
说是巡逻，更像是某种观光。德·托莱多将干员宿舍称为她的“寝宫”，将疗养庭院称为她的“花园”，将工程部称为她的“军备制造厂”，招来了不少非议。德·托莱多丝毫不在意周遭对她的评价，她命令在伊比利亚睡惯潮湿地板的孩子躺上她自己柔软的床垫；搀着病入膏肓的老人去疗养庭院闻一闻海边没有的花香；还有那些胆小却能造出结实玩意儿的年轻人，德·托莱多一把将他们推进工程部，三天之后，年轻人和工程部干员的眼睛里都放着光，比她还啰嗦地介绍新发明的设备。久而久之，抱怨德·托莱多蛮横举动的声音就跟投诉她占用活动室的信件一样消失了。只要和她接触过的人都会明白，德·托莱多是个做的跟说的一样多的人——鉴于她说的实在太多，她为自己拥护者做的足以让人暂时遗忘“拥护者”其实是上了她当的“受害者”——

受害者？我不明白……德·托莱多大人不是风暴，我们又怎么会因为她“受害”？我从鳞脊镇一路跟大人来到这里，身上什么都没有，大人就让我负责做饭，给大伙煮海藻汤。当然，不是什么时候都能捞到足够的海藻，我们会往里面掺点沙子。她说等她找到一个可靠的资助人，或者是有了自己的庄园，就把我们都接过去，喝只有海藻的海藻汤。我知道这里不是大人的家，但我在都是桌椅的地方领到了汤，德·托莱多大人没有欺骗我。什么？她的身份？有时候她确实不太像贵族，但我们也不知道伊比利亚的贵族到底是什么样子，不是吗？如果那些已经埋在土里的贵族老爷能跟大人一样，就很不错了。啊，我想起来了，之前也有拥护者质疑她，她向我们证明了她的贵族血统。海军军装？不，不是指那个。你们知道，她有十一根脚趾吗？
——德·托莱多的拥护者，一名普通的伊比利亚老人，拦住档案记录员说道

text.en:
"On the De Toledo Family Lineage and Eleven Toes"
Esteban Enriques De Toledo, an Iberian Royal Navy admiral during the Golden Age, possessed a steadfast character and immense pride. An outstanding helmsman and navigator, he was hailed by Iberians of his time as "De Toledo the Wave-Turner." Across his eighty-three years of life, he spent nearly seventy at sea. No matter how severe the storm threatening his vessel, he would stand at the fore of the deck. Countless sailors looked up to him as a role model, and extreme emulation drastically raised both mortality and promotion rates among sailors at the time.
However, after the Profound Silence, Rhea-Iberia sank, and extensive records regarding the royal family and nobility were lost. Word-of-mouth recollections and sparse remaining documents revealed a lesser-known side of this noble. Esteban Enriques De Toledo suffered from hereditary polydactyly. Deformed extra toes caused him to limp on flat land, whereas the pitching of a ship conveniently disguised his physical flaw. His navigational mastery may have been an innate talent, or perhaps the result of arduous effort to cover his disability for the sake of his pride.
The same tragedy befell his offspring. His heir, Estanislao, became a brilliant naval admiral; had the Profound Silence not occurred, he too would have spent his life at sea like his father. Rumor has it that when the Profound Silence struck, he leaped from his ship and limped out of Rhea-Iberia, vanishing without a trace ever since.
Today, Estefania Colon De Toledo, claiming to be the great-granddaughter of Esteban Enriques De Toledo, has re-emerged. Both her naval uniform and her eleven toes serve to attest to her identity. We ought to follow in her footsteps and revive the glory of the Iberian Royal Navy...

[A note tucked between book pages]
I didn't expect that after resigning from HR, the first task De Toledo assigned me would be writing her biography. Well, there have always been plenty of followers who doubted her noble origin. Most of the above content was extracted from the stories she told and strung back together logically. I am quite certain De Toledo is not a descendant of that great naval admiral, but I am indeed curious whether she truly has eleven toes, and if not, how she managed to deceive the followers seeking proof. Four days after the question arose, I found the answer in another story she told. Perhaps it is yet another tale she spun based on Iberian reality, but I shall record it for now:
There was once a poor Iberian woman whose husband was swallowed by the sea, leaving her to await childbirth alone. Due to a breech presentation, the infant's feet emerged first. That unfortunate child likewise suffered from polydactyly. The deeply devout woman believed she had birthed a Seaborn and fainted dead away. The child survived unharmed, but the woman took her own life. Raised by the villagers, the child was unable to perform manual labor due to her extra toes. She left the village, and her whereabouts thereafter remain unknown.
text.zh:
《德·托莱多家族血统遗传与十一根脚趾考》
埃斯特班·恩里克斯·德·托莱多，伊比利亚黄金时代王室海军将领，性格刚毅、自尊心极高，是出色的舵手和领航员，被当时的伊比利亚人称作“翻动波涛的德·托莱多”。八十三年的人生中，他有近七十年在海上度过，无论舰船面临多大的风暴，他都会伫立在甲板最前端，无数水手以他为榜样，极端的效仿行为让当时水手的死亡率以及晋升率都大幅提高。
然而大静谧后，雷亚-伊比利亚沉没，大量关于王室和贵族的资料遗失，口口相传的回忆以及为数不多的记载显露出这位贵族鲜为人知的另一面。埃斯特班·恩里克斯·德·托莱多患有家族遗传的多趾症，畸形、多余的脚趾令他在平地走路时一瘸一拐，而船只的颠簸恰能掩盖他的缺陷。航海上的造诣或许是他的天赋使然，亦或许是他为了自尊心掩盖残疾所作努力的成果。
同样的悲剧也发生在他的子嗣身上，他的继承者埃斯塔尼斯劳成了出色的海军将领，若无大静谧，他也将同他父亲一样终生在海上度过。据传言，大静谧来临时他跳下舰船，一瘸一拐逃出了雷亚-伊比利亚，从此销声匿迹。
如今，埃斯特菲尼娅·科隆·德·托莱多，自称埃斯特班·恩里克斯·德·托莱多的曾孙重新现身，海军军装和十一根脚趾无不在印证她的身份，我们应当追随她的脚步，重振伊比利亚王室海军的荣耀……

【一条夹在书页中的小记】
没想到我辞去人事部工作后，德·托莱多交予我的第一项任务是为她立传。也是，怀疑她贵族身份的拥护者一向不少。上述内容大部分是从她讲述的故事中摘录出来，再重新用逻辑串联的。我很确信德·托莱多并非那名伟大海军将领的后裔，但我确实也好奇她是否真的拥有十一根脚趾，如果不是，她又是怎么骗过寻求证明的拥护者的。疑问产生后的第四天，我从她讲的另一个故事里找到了答案，或许这又是一个她基于伊比利亚现实编撰出来的故事，但我姑且将它记下：
曾有一个贫穷的伊比利亚女人，她的丈夫被大海吞没，她独自等待临盆。分娩时因为胎位不正，胎儿的脚先出来。那个不幸的孩子同样患有多趾症，极度虔诚的女人以为自己诞下了一只恐鱼，晕死过去。后来孩子平安无事，但女人自戕了。孩子由村子里的人抚养，她增生的脚趾让她无法从事体力工作。她离开了村子，之后她的下落无人知晓。

text.en:
[Field Operation Record from a Stationed Iberian Office Operator]
Before formally working with Operator De Toledo, I had quite a few reservations regarding her style. Leaving aside how she brings a grand entourage of followers wherever she goes and clears her throat to begin a speech at the sight of any small patch of open ground, before every mission, this restless Liberi vanishes completely. At times when I was uncertain whether such actions were appropriate according to Iberian customs, our nominal "guide" was practically nowhere to be seen.
Ever since Rhea-Iberia returned to the coastline and the Inquisition decided to lift the blockade, our work has become harder than ever. Legacy of the Golden Age is gradually returning to people's lives, and the faith of Iberians is undergoing a restructuring. Some citizens no longer blindly obey the doctrines issued by the Inquisition; meanwhile, those who shaped their lives around faith claim to have been "betrayed." On one occasion, a fasting Iberian actively refused our assistance, reciting old scripture to chase us away, so we left. Half an hour later, a furious De Toledo appeared before us.
That was the first time I had ever seen De Toledo angry. I had previously seen her wandering near that civilian's wooden hut; perhaps he was one of her prospective followers. But she simply handed me a list containing dozens of names, half of which were crossed off. She told me that one of her followers was the town's sugar distributor. Every afternoon, he would haul unrefined sugar from the sugarcane farm and deliver a little to everyone on the list. The wish he made to the great noble De Toledo was that he hoped he would no longer have to cross off names from that list.
The next day, De Toledo built a small podium outside that Iberian's door. On the third day, she spoke for ten consecutive hours. Just as the sun was about to dip below the ocean horizon, the Iberian inside the house replied to her. On the fourth day, she "blessed" the unrefined sugar using so-called "family maxims"—it was utterly absurd, yet that man licked a taste of sugar off the dish. With that, our relief mission came to a successful conclusion, and she gained a loyal follower.
On the way back to Rhodes Island, I apologized to her while congratulating De Toledo's crew on gaining another member. She didn't laugh and slap my arm like she usually did. She looked at the followers gathered around her; they called her the noblest person in Iberia, a title that previously belonged to the Saints of the Inquisition in their eyes.
I seem to understand what she was worried about. In an Iberia that remains turbulent, she needs to be "Noble De Toledo," and she needs to offer a choice to those Iberians who "suffered betrayal." Perhaps only when the majority of Iberians can place faith in themselves will she choose to deceive no longer.
text.zh:
【伊比利亚办事处一名外派干员的行动记录】
在与干员德·托莱多正式合作之前，我对她的行事风格颇有微词。先不说她到哪儿都带着浩浩荡荡的一批拥护者，有一小片空地就会清清嗓子开始演说，每次任务前，这个闲不住的黎博利都会彻底跑没影，在我无法确定按照伊比利亚的习俗这样行动是否合适时，这位名义上的“向导”基本不会在我们身边。
自雷亚-伊比利亚重回伊比利亚海岸线，审判庭决定解除伊比利亚的封锁之后，我们的工作比以往更加艰难。黄金时代的遗产逐渐回归人们的生活，伊比利亚人的信仰正在重组。部分民众不再对审判庭颁布的教义言听计从；而另一边，用信仰划定生活形状的人们声称自己遭受了“背叛”。一次，一名绝食的伊比利亚人主动拒绝了我们的帮助，他念诵旧版的经文驱赶我们，我们离开了。半小时之后，怒气冲冲的德·托莱多出现在我们面前。
这是我第一次见到德·托莱多生气。我曾经看到她在那个平民的木屋附近游荡，或许那是她的潜在拥护者之一。但她只是给了我一份名单，上面列着几十个名字，半数已经被划去。她告诉我，她手下的一名拥护者是这个镇子的配糖员，他每天下午会从甘蔗农场运出粗糖，给名单上的每个人送去一点。他向伟大的贵族德·托莱多许的愿望是，他希望自己不用再划去名单上的名字。
第二天，德·托莱多在那个伊比利亚人的家门口搭了一个小讲台。第三天，她连续讲了十个小时，太阳要从海面消失不见的时候，门内的伊比利亚人回了她一句。第四天，她用所谓的“家族训言”给粗糖“赐福”——不伦不类，但那人舔了一口碟子中的糖。至此，我们的扶助任务圆满结束，她收获了一名忠实的拥护者。
返回罗德岛的路上，我向她道歉，同时恭喜德·托莱多的队伍再添一员。她没像往常那样拍着我的胳膊嘻嘻哈哈。她看着簇拥在她身边的拥护者们，他们称她为伊比利亚最高尚之人，在此之前这个称号在他们口中属于审判庭的圣徒。
我似乎明白了她在担心什么。在依旧动荡的伊比利亚，她需要是“贵族德·托莱多”，她需要给“遭受背叛”的伊比利亚人一个选择。或许只有大部分伊比利亚人都能信仰自身时，她才会选择不再欺骗。

text.en:
"Ahem... Minutes of the Third Joint Meeting between the De Toledo Naval Reserve and Rhodes Island..."
"Doctor, can this little gadget really record everything we say? Hey, wait, you didn't turn on the recording while I was secretly telling you the truth, did you?"
"Right, right, right! The recording is on now, and everything I'm saying is true, all of it!"
"Getting back to the point, this meeting is to report the general status of the preparations for the Naval Reserve I founded, funded by Rhodes Island."
"Personnel recruitment, nautical training, and weapon manufacturing are all progressing steadily with very bright prospects. I suggest increasing investment—hey, don't pull up the mission records!"
"..."
"Don't go silent on me! How does saving two children from human traffickers not count as personnel recruitment? How does rowing a boat to gather seaweed not count as nautical training? And as for weapon manufacturing—hand cannons and swords are only useful in the hands of Inquisition folks; our weapons should be plows and shovels!"
"I have to let my followers live good lives first before I can think about anything else. Trust me, I may deceive, but I never break a promise!"
"Doctor, you agree to increase the investment? There's a condition?"
"...Incorporate my experiences with my followers into the stories for your speeches?"
"Piece of cake! I promise you, you'll definitely be the very first listener!"
text.zh:
“咳咳……德·托莱多海军预备队与罗德岛合作第三次会议记录……”
“博士，这个小东西真能录下我们所有的对话？欸，不对，你不会在我偷偷跟你说真话的时候也开录音了吧？”
“对对对，现在录音也开着，我说的都是真话，都是！”
“说回正题，这次会议是为了汇报由我组建的海军预备队在罗德岛资助下的筹备概况。”
“人员招募、航海训练、武器制造都在稳步进行，前景十分乐观，建议增加投资——欸，不要调取行动记录啊！”
“……”
“别不说话啊，从人贩子手里救了两个孩子怎么不算人员招募？划船捞海藻怎么不算航海训练？还有武器制造——手炮和剑只有在审判庭的人手里才有用处，我们的武器应该是犁和铁锹！”
“我得先让拥护者们好好生活，才能再想点别的。相信我，我虽然骗人但从不食言的！”
“博士，你同意增加投资啦？有个条件？”
“……把我跟拥护者的经历也编进故事里宣讲？”
“小意思！我向你保证，你一定会是第一个听众！”
